tasks.title: Implement input validation utility
tasks.description: Create a centralized validation module to ensure data integrity before API calls. This includes validating task titles, status values, page IDs, and other inputs.
tasks.rationale: Input validation prevents invalid API calls, reduces errors, and improves system reliability. Must be completed first as other tasks depend on it.
acceptance_criteria: Validation function for task titles (non-empty, max length)
Validation function for status values (enum check)
Validation function for Notion page IDs (format check)
Validation function for notes (max length)
Clear validation error messages
Export all validation functions from dedicated module

tasks.title: Enhance error handling in createTask
tasks.description: Improve the createTask function with robust error handling, including specific error types, detailed logging, and validation integration.
tasks.rationale: Current error handling is basic and doesn't distinguish between different failure types. Enhanced error handling improves debugging and system reliability.
acceptance_criteria: Validate inputs using T001 validation functions
Catch and classify different error types (authentication, network, validation)
Provide detailed error messages with context
Return structured error objects instead of undefined
Log errors with appropriate severity levels

tasks.title: Enhance error handling in updateTask
tasks.description: Improve the updateTask function with robust error handling, input validation, and better status management.
tasks.rationale: Similar to createTask, updateTask needs comprehensive error handling to ensure system reliability.
acceptance_criteria: Validate inputs using T001 validation functions
Verify page ID exists before attempting update
Validate status transitions are allowed
Handle partial update failures gracefully
Return success/failure status clearly

tasks.title: Implement task retrieval functions
tasks.description: Add functions to retrieve task details from Notion database, including get by ID and query by properties.
tasks.rationale: Complete CRUD operations require read capability. This enables task status checking, verification, and querying.
acceptance_criteria: Function to get task by page ID
Function to query tasks by status
Function to list all tasks with pagination
Return structured task objects with all properties
Handle not-found scenarios gracefully
Validate inputs before querying

tasks.title: Implement task deletion function
tasks.description: Add capability to archive/delete tasks from the Notion database.
tasks.rationale: Completes full CRUD operations. Notion uses archiving instead of hard deletion.
acceptance_criteria: Function to archive task by page ID
Validate page ID before attempting deletion
Return confirmation of successful archival
Handle already-archived tasks gracefully
Log deletion actions for audit trail

tasks.title: Implement comprehensive status management
tasks.description: Create a status management system with defined status values, transition rules, and validation.
tasks.rationale: Ensures consistent status handling across all operations and prevents invalid status transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Define all valid status values as constants
Implement status transition validation
Function to get next valid statuses for current status
Status history tracking capability
Integration with updateTask validation

tasks.title: Implement task filtering and querying
tasks.description: Extend task retrieval with advanced filtering capabilities including assignee, date ranges, and compound filters.
tasks.rationale: Enables sophisticated task management workflows and reporting capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Filter tasks by assignee
Filter tasks by date created/modified
Combine multiple filters
Support sorting options
Pagination support for large result sets
Return count of matching tasks

tasks.title: Implement retry mechanism with exponential backoff
tasks.description: Create a retry utility that handles transient failures with exponential backoff strategy.
tasks.rationale: Network and API issues are common; automatic retry improves reliability without manual intervention.
acceptance_criteria: Configurable max retry attempts
Exponential backoff algorithm (2^n seconds)
Optional jitter to prevent thundering herd
Retry only on retryable errors (not 4xx client errors)
Log retry attempts with context
Timeout handling per attempt

tasks.title: Implement API rate limiting handler
tasks.description: Create rate limiting mechanism to respect Notion API rate limits and handle 429 responses.
tasks.rationale: Notion API has rate limits; proper handling prevents service disruption and ensures compliance.
acceptance_criteria: Track API call frequency
Implement token bucket or sliding window algorithm
Automatically throttle requests when approaching limits
Handle 429 rate limit responses with appropriate delays
Expose rate limit status for monitoring
Queue requests when rate limited

tasks.title: Implement batch operations for tasks
tasks.description: Create functions to perform bulk operations on multiple tasks efficiently.
tasks.rationale: Batch operations improve efficiency when managing multiple tasks and reduce API call overhead.
acceptance_criteria: Batch create multiple tasks in one call
Batch update task statuses
Batch archive tasks
Handle partial failures gracefully (continue on error)
Return detailed results for each operation
Respect rate limits during batch operations
Transaction-like rollback on critical failures (optional)

tasks.title: Implement structured logging system
tasks.description: Replace console.log statements with a structured logging system that supports different log levels and formats.
tasks.rationale: Structured logging improves debugging, monitoring, and production observability.
acceptance_criteria: Support log levels: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR
Configurable log level via environment variable
Structured log format with timestamps
Context information in logs (operation, task ID, etc.)
Optional log output to file
Replace all console.log calls with logger

tasks.title: Add comprehensive error handling across all functions
tasks.description: Integrate retry logic, rate limiting, and structured logging into all API interaction functions.
tasks.rationale: Unifies error handling approach across codebase and ensures consistent behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All API calls wrapped with retry handler
Rate limiting applied to all Notion API calls
Structured logging for all operations
Consistent error response format
Error categorization (recoverable vs non-recoverable)
Graceful degradation where possible

tasks.title: Create comprehensive test suite
tasks.description: Implement unit and integration tests for all functions using a testing framework.
tasks.rationale: Tests ensure code quality, prevent regressions, and document expected behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for all public functions
Mock Notion API for testing
Integration tests with test database (optional)
Test error scenarios and edge cases
Test validation functions thoroughly
Test batch operations
Achieve >80% code coverage
Tests can run via npm test command

tasks.title: Add configuration validation on startup
tasks.description: Implement startup validation to check environment variables and Notion API connectivity before executing operations.
tasks.rationale: Fail-fast approach prevents cryptic errors during operation and improves developer experience.
acceptance_criteria: Validate NOTION_API_KEY is set and non-empty
Validate NOTION_DATABASE_ID is set and non-empty
Test Notion API connectivity on startup
Verify database exists and is accessible
Provide clear error messages for configuration issues
Exit gracefully if configuration invalid

tasks.title: Create documentation and usage examples
tasks.description: Write comprehensive documentation including API reference, usage examples, setup instructions, and troubleshooting guide.
tasks.rationale: Documentation enables other developers to use the system effectively and reduces support burden.
acceptance_criteria: Update README.md with complete setup instructions
Document all public functions with parameters and return values
Provide usage examples for common scenarios
Document environment variable requirements
Create troubleshooting section for common errors
Add JSDoc comments to all exported functions
Include example .env file template
